zh-CN.name: Anatomy 交互等距插图
zh-CN.shortDesc: 将技术概念制作成可交互的等距 SVG/HTML 插图，可选 WebGL、3D 与 A4/Letter PDF 打印。需另备 Node.js 20.10+；检查与 PDF 打印需 Chrome/Chromium，React 输出另需 React 18+。适用于能读取技能并运行本地脚本的 Agent；不会自动安装这些依赖，缺失时停止相关构建或检查，不虚构结果。

en-US.name: Anatomy
en-US.shortDesc: Build interactive isometric SVG/HTML explanations, with optional WebGL, 3D and A4/Letter PDF printing. Supply Node.js 20.10+; checks and PDF printing need Chrome/Chromium, React output needs React 18+. For agents able to read skills and run local scripts. Dependencies are not auto-installed; stop affected builds/checks when unavailable, never fabricate results.
